ecologically: Ecologically means with respect to ecology.
For example: "Ecologically speaking, this idea is brilliant."
economically: Economically means with respect to economic science.
For example: "Economically this proposal makes no sense."
Economically can also mean in an economical manner.
Economically can also mean with respect to the economic system.
ecstatically: Ecstatically means in an ecstatic manner.
For example: "He reacted ecstatically to my plan to travel to Africa."
Ecstatically means the same as rapturously or rhapsodically.
